messages:
jordan-support: FYI customer 'BrightSky' reported a 403 on inference requests after they rotated their KMS CMK last night. They say it worked before rotation.
maria-sec: Thanks — can you paste the KMS error string from the app logs? 403 could be envelope/decrypt, or IAM deny.
jordan-support: App log: "KMS:AccessDenied: user is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:222222:key/abcd-efgh". Customer also shared CloudTrail but says they don't see any ReEncrypt events.
akshay-eng: Do we have the envelope AAD in the request? If the associated-data (aad) changed between encrypt/decrypt -> Decrypt will fail with AccessDenied in some SDKs.
jordan-support: They said our SDK sets aad to "env:prod,team=payments". Ops said they added a short-lived session tag that includes `project=bright-sky` via STS session tags at rotation time.
maria-sec: That screams AAD mismatch. Rotation flow probably rewrapped ciphertext without including same AAD, or the app started sending different AADs after automation. Need to validate both sides.
infra-bot: incident-bot created INC-2026 and linked to this thread :rotating_light:.
akshay-eng: Quick checks: 1) Verify the CMK policy allows Decrypt for the service principal used by the rewrap job. 2) Check any Grants created for cross-account rewrap — grants bypass some IAM checks but require grant tokens in the rewrap call. 3) Ensure CloudTrail has KMS Data plane events enabled to see ReEncrypt/Decrypt.
june-cs: Customer is asking for a quick checklist to unblock prod.
maria-sec: Minimal checklist to send them:
- Confirm CMK key policy + IAM principal includes kms:Decrypt and kms:ReEncrypt* for the rewrap principal (explicit allow).
- If using Grants for cross-account, ensure the rewrap process obtains and passes the grant token.
- Verify the app's AAD / "associatedData" is identical for encrypt and decrypt phases.
- Enable CloudTrail DataEvents for KMS (or filter events) to surface ReEncrypt and Decrypt calls.
- Check for IAM condition keys (aws:RequestTag / kms:EncryptionContextSubset) that might block decrypts after rotation.
jordan-support: Sending that to customer now. They replied: "We do use session tags in the STS role assumed by our rotation lambda — maybe that changed. Logs from the lambda show ReEncrypt but no Decrypt calls from our app post-rotation."
akshay-eng: If lambda re-encrypts ciphertext into a new envelope but doesn't preserve EncryptionContext / AAD, decrypt will fail. Also Lambda might be using Grants but not returning token to downstream client.
maria-sec: Also watch for subtle RBAC: we recently advised them to tighten IAM to least privilege. If they changed `kms:Decrypt` to only allow requests with `kms:EncryptionContext:team=payments`, and the session tags now set `team=pay`, decrypt is denied.
jordan-support: They provided the CMK policy snippet. Pasted:
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRotation",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::333333:role/rotation-lambda"},
  "Action": ["kms:ReEncryptTo", "kms:ReEncryptFrom", "kms:Encrypt"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
maria-sec: Missing kms:Decrypt allow for the app principal. Also it's safer to include explicit kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt for the service that actually handles unwrapping in-app.
akshay-eng: Proposed remediation steps for customer (sendable):
- Add kms:Decrypt+kms:GenerateDataKey to the application IAM role on the CMK key policy.
- If using grants for cross-account, modify the rewrap lambda to return the grant token to the client (or rewrap into a CMK usable by the app principal).
- Freeze rotation until we validate AAD/encryption context parity across all components.
- Turn on CloudTrail DataEvents for the KMS key and check for ReEncrypt/Decrypt pairs.
- If audit logs are missing, check S3 bucket lifecycle for CloudTrail or CloudTrail integration region mismatch.
june-cs: Customer ack'd and wants us to check their CloudTrail. They shared one CloudTrail file — I uploaded it to the support ticket.
infra-bot: deploy-bot noted that our internal re-encrypt helper service rolled 2 updates yesterday (service/rewrap-helper v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3)
maria-sec: Flag: confirm our helper didn't change EncryptionContext semantics. I'll open internal PR review against rewrap-helper repo.
akshay-eng: For long-term docs: add a section on "Envelope encryption rotation pitfalls" covering AAD/encryption-context parity, Grants vs IAM, grant-token propagation, and CloudTrail DataEvent checks.
jordan-support: Customer fixed IAM policy to include kms:Decrypt for app role and rewrap lambda updated to include EncryptionContext copy. They report requests are green again.
maria-sec: Nice. Action items for us:
- [ ] Update Support KB with checklist (AAD, Grants, Decrypt allow, CloudTrail DataEvents)
- [ ] Create internal postmortem note in eng-security about rewrap-helper change
- [ ] Add a short troubleshooting snippet for Azure Key Vault (Managed HSM) differences: KV encrypt/decrypt vs wrapKey unwrapKey semantics and AAD handling.
june-cs: I'll open a docs ticket and link INC-2026.
infra-bot: ticket SPT-429 created for KB update
akshay-eng: Quick config snippet to add for AWS CLI to validate decrypt locally:
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id alias/customer-cmk --encryption-context '{"env":"prod","team":"payments"}'
```
maria-sec: Also add note: when rotating with ReEncrypt, the principal doing ReEncrypt must have both source and target CMK privileges.
jordan-support: Closing loop with customer, marking incident resolved. :white_check_mark:.
infra-bot: incident-bot updated INC-2026 -> resolved
